name: Algebraic Subgraph Constraint
description: Replaces the explicit graph-connectivity requirement ("connect all core factions") with an equivalent algebraic constraint on binary vertex variables ($E = V - 1$). On a tree, this equation holds if and only if the chosen vertices form a single connected component. Models relying on surface patterns will fail to recognize the Steiner tree problem and will likely attempt an intractable state-space DP, while models that can reason about graph properties will deduce the connectivity requirement and succeed.
